solutions.title: Row simulation with direction flips
solutions.strategy: Append each character to its current row and flip direction whenever the top or bottom row is reached.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each character is appended once and row strings are joined once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The row builders store all characters before the final join.

solutions.title: Cycle index walk
solutions.strategy: For each row, jump through the string by the zigzag cycle length and include diagonal middle-row characters when present.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every character index is appended exactly once across all row scans.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output builder stores the converted string.
